title: fix(cli): send X-Polli-Client from gen chat
author: zilin6666-svg

gist.summary: Fixed `polli gen chat` to send `X-Polli-Client: cli/<version>` using the shared `POLLI_CLIENT` constant, matching other CLI generation commands. The tracking middleware can now record chat requests under `polliClientVersion` as CLI usage. Added a regression test for the header.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli wears tiny headphones and checks a retro chat terminal as a lime green (#ecf874) request carrying a small 'CLI' tag travels toward a glowing counter beside sprouting code-plants. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small within the scene, rendered in cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
